messages:
sre-maria: Seeing a weird slow-start on control plane after the EU canary loadtest ramp. controller-manager leader flip twice in 2m and a ton of requeues. stalling reconciles for GPU nodepool objects.
infra-cheng: Graphs? which region?
platform-ops: eu-west1. I can see api-server p95 latency spike ~7s at 08:12 UTC, correlates with etcd write latencies.
oncall-bot: ALERT: kube-controller-manager leader-election frequency high (2 events) — auto-notify sent to #eng-sre.
eng-ryan: Any recent infra changes? quoter: we deployed autoscaler tuning yesterday for GPU pools.
sre-maria: Yeah autoscaler went live at 07:50. It increased scale-up parallelism for the nvidia-pool; cloud provider API started returning 429s around 08:10. controller-manager is thrashing on node objects because the cloudprovider calls are rate-limited.
dave-sre: Ok that chain makes sense. If cloud API 429s cause long backoffs, controller-manager holds leader lease renewals and triggers elections. Can we confirm 429s in controller logs?
platform-ops: Pasting quick tail from controller-manager logs:
```
E0809 08:11:20.123456 1 node_controller.go:345] failed to get node from cloud provider: 429 Too Many Requests
W0809 08:11:21.654321 1 leaderelection.go:290] failed to renew lease: context deadline exceeded
I0809 08:11:22.000000 1 leaderelection.go:180] attempting to acquire leader lease
```

infra-cheng: That's the smoking gun. Also etcd latency climbs when API frontends flood with retries. GPU provisioning parallelism created a burst of cloud API calls.
sre-maria: Quick mitigation: rollback autoscaler tuning (reduce parallelism), and temporarily throttle cloudprovider QPS in controller-manager flags. Can someone flip the autoscaler config?
platform-ops: Rolling back autoscaler change now. patch applied.
eng-ryan: While that's happening, can we bump lease duration to avoid elections during transient spikes? risk: longer leader hold if leader gone.
dave-sre: Short-term OK: increase --leader-elect-lease-duration to 15s (was 8s). That should reduce churn. I'll open a PR to revert later and document tradeoff.
platform-ops: Autoscaler rollback complete at 08:18 UTC. cloud provider 429s dropping. api-server p95 down to ~300ms.
sre-maria: Logs show renewals again, controller-manager stabilized. Planning follow-ups: audit autoscaler parallelism, add cloudprovider rate-limit config in our runbooks, and add a canary throttling guard for GPU pool bursts.
eng-ryan: Also add a synthetic test that simulates aggressive GPU onboarding during off-hours to catch this earlier.
infra-cheng: Will add a quota backoff on autoscaler side and put a cap per-minute. Filing an infra ticket: INFRA-8245.
sre-maria: Thanks all — marking thread resolved. Will post a short retrospective in the eng-sre weekly notes. :thumbsup:
